rulesStrings.li: questName->[trainee_nameFull]'s officer training
questName->[newTitle] training requirement: [trainee_nameFull]
questName->Fleet service education notice
questAskerReason->[asker_nameFull], a training instructor of [issuerFactionName], has passed a course notice on to the colony.
questAskerReason->[asker_nameFull], the case officer handling this for [issuerFactionName], has sent formal notice over the fleet band.
questAskerReason->The service education command of [issuerFactionName] has mailed a formal notice to [playerFactionName].

questTrainee->[trainee_nameFull] has the service record for the rank of [newTitle], but fleet command requires officers of that grade to log enough course hours before the post can be formally conferred.

questTrainee->[trainee_nameFull] is now carried on the Colonial Forces' promotion roll for [newTitle]. Regulations, however, forbid conferring that grade on anyone who has not sat a formal military training course.

questTrainee->[asker_nameFull], the officer who signed the notice, points out that [trainee_nameFull]'s promotion to [newTitle] stays on hold until formal military training produces a certificate of qualification.

questExplain->[asker_pronoun] will arrange an orbital transport to carry [trainee_nameDef] to the training establishment for a [trainingDays]-day [courseName], with board and medical care charged to the Colonial Forces.
questExplain->The fleet will requisition an orbital transport to collect [trainee_nameDef] for [trainingDays] days of instruction at the training centre running the [courseName].
questExplain->[trainee_nameDef] will train at the centre for [trainingDays] days, with board for the duration charged to the Colonial Forces.

questEndExplain->On graduation [trainee_pronoun] will be granted the rank of [newTitle] at the centre and returned to us, having gained the relevant experience and, quite possibly, shed a bad habit along the way.
questEndExplain->Once the course is complete [trainee_nameDef] will be commissioned and returned to [playerFactionName] intact.

questWarning->Note that [trainee_nameDef] falls under [issuerFactionName] military discipline for the duration of the course. Should [playerFactionName] turn hostile, the trainee will be detained as the regulations provide.

arrivedLetterLabel->Personnel transport arrived
arrivedLetterLabel->Personnel transport landed
arrivedLetterText->The orbital transport requisitioned by [askerName] has landed. [traineeName] must board it for the [courseName] at the [issuerFactionName] training centre.
graduateLetterLabel->Graduated: [traineeName]
graduateLetterLabel->[traineeName] commissioned [newTitle]

graduateLetterText->[traineeName] has completed the [courseName] and is being returned by drop pod, promoted from [oldTitle] to [newTitle] by order of [issuerFactionName].\n\nThe course record notes a marked improvement in [skillName].
graduateNoTraitLetterLabel->Graduated: [traineeName]
graduateNoTraitLetterLabel->[traineeName] commissioned [newTitle]

graduateNoTraitLetterText->[traineeName] has completed the [courseName] and is being returned by drop pod, promoted from [oldTitle] to [newTitle] by order of [issuerFactionName].\n\nThe instructors found nothing in [traineeName]'s discipline worth correcting, so they spent the time on the syllabus instead. The [skillName] instruction on record runs well past the standard for the grade.
capturedLetterLabel->[traineeName] detained by [issuerFactionName]
capturedLetterLabel->Trainee detained

capturedLetterText->[issuerFactionName] went to war with [playerFactionName] while [traineeName] was still at the training establishment. The service education command has handed [traineeName] over to the provost.\n\n[traineeName] is not coming back on a transport. Getting [traineeName] out is our problem now.
abortLetterLabel->Course allocation withdrawn
abortLetterText->Hostilities with [issuerFactionName] have voided the course allocation for [traineeName]. The transport has been recalled.
missedLetterLabel->Transport left empty

missedLetterText->The transport requisitioned by [askerName] has departed. [issuerFactionName] has struck [traineeName] from the roll for this run of the officer training course; the promotion will have to wait for another opportunity.
